notes.title: Secret Files unlocked and Steam Deck update
notes.content:
It's been more than two years since we first released Last Days of Lazarus on Steam! How time flies!

We've just updated the game to version 1.1, bringing a new feature, the Secret Files. Once you've completed the game, you can find a new option in the main menu, called Secret Files. Inside you will find the Secret Service reports regarding the game's characters. Find out new insights about the protagonists of our story and confirm your suspicions about their past. We hope you enjoy this bonus feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38355698/575ff87586e6e6347b28b36513cb6d8afa4071cf.jpg[/img]

Last Days of Lazarus has recently been tested by Valve for the Steam Deck Compatibility program and we got a Playable status. Which we're happy for, but we're not just going to settle for that without a fight. This new update also includes updated default settings for Steam Deck and a bunch of other small fixes and tweaks targeting the console. So we're reapplying for testing in hopes we can get the coveted Verified badge. Wish us luck!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695260/The_Crimson_Maid/

Thank you for all your support throughout these years! And don't forget to wishlist the cool new game we've been working on, The Crimson Maid. You can also play the demo if you haven't already. Cheers!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1
notes.content:
Changes for Patch v1.0.1:
- fixed bug causing possible gameplay block in Bran - basement blocking wall after placing chalice ingredients now only activates if the clamps are also placed
- fixed settings always remaining dirty and getting resaved each time
- changed the model for the Some Toy collectible
- removed tesselation on some skin materials for Lyudmila and Zhivko to avoid potential visual issues on some GPU models
- disabled motion blur in menus to avoid potential visual issues on some GPU models
- replaced first aid kit texture in Kolyma
- replaced some pills textures in the apartment

notes.title: Mark the date: June 22nd!
notes.content:
We are super excited to announce that Last Days of Lazarus will finally be arriving on Steam on June 22nd 2022. Join Lazarus in his quest to reconnect with his sister and to find out more about his family, all while unexplainable events and political turmoil surround him.

[previewyoutube=v4GKtqx8N7I;full][/previewyoutube]
Meet questionable characters and explore both oppressive and eerily beautiful locations inspired by post communist Romania. Delve deep into the story through letters, documents and hidden collectibles. Solve intuitive puzzles to progress or unlock optional insights into this disturbed family's story.

[h2]What to expect[/h2]
Last Days of Lazarus is a collaboration between Darkania Works and GrimTalin, made in Unreal Engine 4 over the course of more than two and a half years. We are two tiny indie studios from Iasi, Romania. The game is heavily inspired from our local religious and supernatural beliefs and the places and times we grew up in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38355698/81f4895086718e643d739ede52b95faeb0fe2e65.jpg[/img]

The story is split into eight chapters and you'll be visiting five locations. We estimate new players will take three to four hours to finish the game, depending on how observant you are and if you want to find all the documents and collectibles and experience all the content. If you are a collectionist, you can keep track of your status for each chapter and choose to replay any of them if you've missed something.

Please wishlist the game if you haven't already and we hope you'll play the game on June 22nd!

notes.title: Beta playtest update
notes.content:
A big thank you to our beta players who had a chance to try the game and have already given us valuable feedback!

The limited beta playtest will be playable up until April 25th, so those who got access and still haven't tried the game have another week at their disposal. We hope to hear your thoughts on the game too!

notes.title: Prologue available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38355698/8a8a4ea4e918af3abdba8ae4bf91024d679b886f.png[/img]

You can now play the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1833810/Last_Days_of_Lazarus__Prologue/]Last Days of Lazarus - Prologue[/url] and enjoy the first two and a half chapters from the full game. The Prologue also comes with the complete set of features the full game will have when it releases in the first part of 2022.

If you've played our previous demo, the story content will be mostly the same, but here is what's new in the Prologue:
[list]
[*] New voice and look for Lazarus
[*] Full controller support, including vibrations
[*] Chapters menu, unlocked after you finish the Prologue
[*] Visual improvements in the Kolyma region
[*] 10 achievements to unlock
[*] Cloud save support, also synced with the full game
[*] Small changes in the script
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38355698/e8d4fc735e09ba9815f8418e468d855b24d5b0e4.png[/img]

The Chapters menu is a great addition for those looking to replay certain acts from the game, maybe to find missed documents or collectibles, or to unlock new achievements. You can check the status of your collected documents and found collectibles for each chapter. When replaying an act, you can choose to skip its intro cutscene, if you want to go straight to exploring.

We hope you enjoy [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1833810/Last_Days_of_Lazarus__Prologue/]Last Days of Lazarus - Prologue[/url]. Please leave us a review and wishlist the full game! The unsettling big release is close...

notes.title: Progress update
notes.content:
It's been a long and difficult process to make Last Days of Lazarus and we feel we're getting very close to the end. We are super excited for the moment you'll be able to play our game, but first we want to make sure it'll be a smooth and memorable experience.

[h3]Dialogue[/h3]
We are working with some great voice actors to record the dialogue in the game. The demo lines have already been recorded and we are very happy with how our characters sound. We are also tweaking the music and sound effects to achieve the suspenseful mood we aim for. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38355698/be2dcd1ae21c633e778fcd4ad9e63be8ad644054.png[/img]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
We are revamping some older puzzles and adding new ones to make for a richer experience. Some of the content in the game is optional, but you'll want to keep an eye out for it to piece together all the details about this family's past.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38355698/8b5e1cd55bedf096ad12fad3f43503011cfd1ec5.png[/img]
[h3]User experience[/h3]
We are going over and improving all aspects related to the user experience, from menus and inventory screens to how you interact with objects in the game. Besides finding and picking up items you can use to solve puzzles, you'll also be able to find and store various documents, such as notes and letters, and collectibles - special items that'll help you peer deeper into the lives of Lazarus and his troubled family.

[h3]Join the chat[/h3]
Did you know that we have a [url=https://discord.gg/FWDkNhm]Discord Server[/url]? Join us to follow the development of Last Days of Lazarus, keep in touch with the developers, chat about games and more! 

We hope to see you on our [url=https://discord.gg/FWDkNhm]Discord Server[/url]!
